clusters.name: Walter's move to Sorrel Valley, 1952–1953
clusters.reason: Around Walter moving the family across the country in March 1952, within a year: June became homesick and wrote to her sister daily, then kept to her bed for weeks; Walter worked out in the trees from dark to dark and they grew distant; Glen had fights at school and was sent home twice; Walter stopped writing to his brother Harlan after a quarrel over their father's land money; Walter and June rowed over money for new trees. By September 1953, when June joined the church choir and her letters thinned out, the shifts settle. The only shift that falls outside this time, that Roy kept back a year at school, is told with no certain date and marked so it does not open a period; Faye's stomach aches are marked the same way.

clusters.name: Walter's orchard failed, 1968–1969
clusters.reason: Around the late frost taking Walter's crop and the bank calling in the loan in May 1968, within a year: Walter drank heavily most nights; he and Glen blamed each other; Glen and Marian took over the family's money and the talks with the bank; Carl's asthma attacks worsened; Nora began wetting the bed; Ida was found to have heart trouble and told to stop working. By October 1969, when Walter stopped drinking and took work pruning other men's trees, the shifts settle. The one shift marked with no certain date and so it does not open a period, Roy stopping to speak to Walter over the sale, falls in the same months and is left out of the period's years.

clusters.name: Glen's layoff at the cannery, 1975–1976
clusters.reason: Around Glen losing his job when the Ridgeport cannery closed in February 1975, within a year: Glen sat out of work most of that year in the truck for hours; he and Marian fought loud at night over money; Marian took a second job cleaning offices at night; Nora stopped eating properly and lost weight; Nora kept to her room and grew distant from Marian; Walter started drinking again after six years off it. By June 1976, when Nora was eating again and made the track team, the shifts settle. Carl's asthma had eased by April 1969, so it is left out. The one shift marked with no certain date, Carl spending most nights at his girlfriend's house, is left out of the period.

clusters.name: Wilma moved into Nora's house, 1990–1991
clusters.reason: Around Wilma selling her farm and moving into Nora and Hollis's house in January 1990, within a year and a half: Nora clashed with Wilma over the children's bedtimes and meals; Hollis worked late and kept out of the rows; he took his mother's side; Owen had tantrums at preschool and was sent home twice; Wilma took over Lily's care; Nora's eczema flared on both hands; Nora and Hollis rowed most nights. By June 1991, when Wilma moved to a flat in town and Nora's eczema cleared over the summer, the shifts settle. The one shift marked with no certain date, Marian driving over twice a week to take Nora's side, falls in the same months and is left out.
